summary: Master data storytelling and executive dashboards. Learn IBCS standards, Tufte's principles, and Power BI to drive strategic decisions. Enroll today.
lede: Data Storytelling and Executive Dashboards helps you transform complex data into focused visual narratives that support executive decision-making. You will learn to structure findings with the Minto Pyramid Principle, apply Gestalt principles to direct attention, and select KPIs that align reporting with organizational objectives. Build practical reporting solutions for real-world constraints such as data quality issues, legacy systems, and limited stakeholder attention. You will create executive scorecards, add drill-through analysis, develop automated workflows, and use AI-assisted features for predictive trend spotting in tools such as Power BI and Tableau.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who already possess a foundational understanding of data analysis and seek to elevate their reporting to a strategic, executive-ready level.
modules: The Art of the Data Narrative
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of at least one business intelligence tool (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or advanced Excel). Experience in managing or analyzing business data for at least two years is recommended. No coding or programming knowledge is required for this course.
